title: 颱風天
summary: Wind, rain and the famous "typhoon day off".
paragraphs: 夏天的時候，臺灣常常有颱風。
颱風來的時候，風很大，雨也很大。
如果颱風太大，政府會放「颱風假」，學生不用上課，很多人也不用上班。
颱風假的前一天，大家會去超市買水、泡麵和麵包。
有的人在家看電視，有的人在家睡覺。
雖然放假很開心，可是颱風也很危險，大家最好不要出門。
translation: In summer, Taiwan often has typhoons.
When a typhoon comes, the wind is strong and the rain is heavy.
If the typhoon is too strong, the government announces a "typhoon day off": students have no classes and many people don't have to work.
The day before, everyone goes to the supermarket to buy water, instant noodles and bread.
Some people watch TV at home; some sleep.
A day off is nice, but typhoons are dangerous, so it's best not to go out.
